messages.text: I applied for a refund on my seat cushion while I was still within the deadline, but the staff member rejected it. Surely that first request keeps my refund window open?

messages.text:
No. A rejected proposal does not keep the refund window open. The 30-day deadline is based on the recorded delivery time, and the exception for an earlier timely proposal does not apply if that proposal was rejected. (refund-policy/v2/window)

Your seat cushion was delivered on October 9, 2026, so the ordinary deadline was November 8, 2026. (refund-policy/v2/eligible-orders) The records show it was returned, but a new proposal now would be outside the deadline. (refund-policy/v2/return) (refund-policy/v2/window)
